FORM.notes: source note: 汶水泰雅不同村之間有b/v, c/s等發音上的差異。清安村發音人較年輕一輩的詞彙已無b和c的音，但較年長的發音人的部分詞彙仍保留b和c的音。此篇語料係依照發音人的發音而給予標記。 | source note: wahi 指吊圈式陷阱. | source note: source ori row restores su and wahi forms; shifted ACC and trap glosses realigned

S.FORM: ulaqi kung sunga' ru rasun kuing ni yava'mu musa' i ragiyax musa' i sumku' su su wahi.
S.PHON: ulaqi kuŋ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ru ra[s|ɕ]un kuiŋ ni ja*aʔmu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i raɣijax mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]u waħi
S.FORM: ulaqi kung sunga' ru rasun kuing ni yava'mu musa' i ragiyax musa' i sumku' su su wahi.
S.PHON: ulaqi kuŋ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ru ra[s|ɕ]un kuiŋ ni ja*aʔmu mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i raɣijax mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]u waħi
S.TRANSL: 以前我還是小孩的時候,我爸爸帶我去山上為了設置陷阱.
When I was a little child, my father brought me, and went to the mountain, and set

FORM.notes: source note: turiq ru 是發語詞, 用來引起聽者注意; turiq-un (start-PF; 叫別人起來, 從躺著的狀態站起來). m-u-tu-turiq (AF-start-RED-start; 自己起來). | source note: halan 意義相當於musa (去). | source note: hani vay (正在做...); tiruwiq (「吊」的名詞型態). | source note: qutux ka vauwak, 都是(數量)一隻的意思,似乎沒有泛指之意.

S.FORM: tuliq ru makatu ru makaspat ga halan mian i mitaal hani vay taruyqun ku qutux ku vauwak.
S.PHON: tuliq ru makatu ru maka[s|ɕ]pat ɣa ħalan mian i mitaal ħani *aj tarujqun ku qutux ku *auwak
S.FORM: tuliq ru makatu ru makaspat ga halan mian i mitaal hani vay taruyqun ku qutux ku vauwak.
S.PHON: tuliq ru makatu ru maka[s|ɕ]pat ɣa ħalan mian i mitaal ħani *aj tarujqun ku qutux ku *auwak
S.TRANSL: 然後,隔了三到四天我們去看,正吊到一隻山豬.
And then, three or four days later, we went to see (the trap), and it was taking place that a hog was hung.

FORM.notes: source note: havau (用刀刺，不是用針刺). 此句中ta和sami都要出現, 皆不可省略.

S.FORM: havaw ta' maha sami.
S.PHON: ħa*aw taʔ maħa [s|ɕ]ami
S.FORM: havaw ta' maha sami.
S.PHON: ħa*aw taʔ maħa [s|ɕ]ami
S.TRANSL: 我們說我們來刺.
We said that we came stabbing (it).

FORM.notes: source note: rumakiyas(上下爬). ima (指定代名詞, 可指稱有生命/無生命名詞; nanuwan則沒有此語法功能).

S.FORM: havunniam ru maisu kung gi ulaqi kuing rumakiyas kuing gi kaisunmu ima kasaunia maha kuing.
S.PHON: ħa*unniam ru mai[s|ɕ]u kuŋ ɣi ulaqi kuiŋ rumakija[s|ɕ] kuiŋ ɣi kai[s|ɕ]unmu ima ka[s|ɕ]aunia maħa kuiŋ
S.FORM: havunniam ru maisu kung gi ulaqi kuing rumakiyas kuing gi kaisunmu ima kasaunia maha kuing.
S.PHON: ħa*unniam ru mai[s|ɕ]u kuŋ ɣi ulaqi kuiŋ rumakija[s|ɕ] kuiŋ ɣi kai[s|ɕ]unmu ima ka[s|ɕ]aunia maħa kuiŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們刺了以後,我會害怕,因為我還是小孩,我爬樹因為我害怕,怕它過來咬我.
We stabbed (it) and, because I was afraid as a kid, I climbed up a tree because I was afraid that it would come and bite me, I thought.

FORM.notes: source note: hani yaku (原來是).

S.FORM: rumkiyas kung hani yaku babaan ku.
S.PHON: rumkija[s|ɕ] kuŋ ħani jaku βaβaan ku
S.FORM: rumkiyas kung hani yaku babaan ku.
S.PHON: rumkija[s|ɕ] kuŋ ħani jaku βaβaan ku
S.TRANSL: 我爬樹,原來那棵樹是陷阱的一部分(木柱).
I climbed the tree, and it turned out that the tree was indeed the pole of the trap.

FORM.notes: source note: asi語意上修飾其後的動詞，單獨使用時根據語境有「只能」、「只有」等語意。和特定的功能詞使用時則修飾其後的命題，有「必要」（asi ki）、「好像」（asi ga, asi gi）等語意。目前將此類用法合併為一個單位標記。 | source note: taqaqutit 原意指常常玩弄糞便的人, 引申為無用之人。 | source note: 此句saan應為salun (對...說); agan應改成siagan.

S.FORM: tuliq kasa'angun kung ni yava'mu nanuwan asigi isu ga taqaqutit hani ka rumakiyas su babaan la saannia muvaaq kuing agannia su vatunux.
S.PHON: tuliq ka[s|ɕ]aʔaŋun kuŋ ni ja*aʔmu nanuwan a[s|ɕ]iɣi i[s|ɕ]u ɣa taqaqutit ħani ka rumakija[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]u βaβaan la [s|ɕ]aannia mu*aaq kuiŋ aɣannia [s|ɕ]u *atunux
S.FORM: tuliq kasa'angun kung ni yava'mu nanuwan asigi isu ga taqaqutit hani ka rumakiyas su babaan la saannia muvaaq kuing agannia su vatunux.
S.PHON: tuliq ka[s|ɕ]aʔaŋun kuŋ ni ja*aʔmu nanuwan a[s|ɕ]iɣi i[s|ɕ]u ɣa taqaqutit ħani ka rumakija[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]u βaβaan la [s|ɕ]aannia mu*aaq kuiŋ aɣannia [s|ɕ]u *atunux
S.TRANSL: 我爸爸就開始罵我,說他"怎麼會有像你這麼沒用的人,去爬那根柱子?" 他叫我下來,並拿起石頭.
My father started scolding me, saying "How come you are so useless, to climb that pole?" Asking me to descend, he grabbed a stone.

FORM.notes: source note: 汶水泰雅口語語料中會有語助詞和其他功能詞(主題標記、連接詞、主格)等連讀的現象（lga, lru, lgi, lku, etc.）。目前將此類例子拆解為兩個單位標記。

S.FORM: rarimania i aruwa havun su awlu la ru.
S.PHON: rarimania i aruwa ħa*un [s|ɕ]u awlu la ru
S.FORM: rarimania i aruwa havun su awlu la ru.
S.PHON: rarimania i aruwa ħa*un [s|ɕ]u awlu la ru
S.TRANSL: 先前他已經刺了山豬喉嚨.
He had already stabbed the hog into its throat.

S.FORM: XXXX tuliq ru tutingunnia su tunux ru mwah sami la.
S.PHON: xxxx tuliq ru tutiŋunnia [s|ɕ]u tunux ru mwaħ [s|ɕ]ami la
S.FORM: XXXX tuliq ru tutingunnia su tunux ru mwah sami la.
S.PHON: xxxx tuliq ru tutiŋunnia [s|ɕ]u tunux ru mwaħ [s|ɕ]ami la
S.TRANSL: 然後,爸爸他打了山豬的頭,然後我們就回來了.
And then, Father beat the hog on the head, and we came back.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-panga (AF型); si-panga (BF型); papruyq-an=nia quw? 他揹得動嗎?

S.FORM: pangania' sipapanga'nia kuing ru ini'mu papruyqi.
S.PHON: paŋaniaʔ [s|ɕ]ipapaŋaʔnia kuiŋ ru iniʔmu paprujqi
S.FORM: pangania' sipapanga'nia kuing ru ini'mu papruyqi.
S.PHON: paŋaniaʔ [s|ɕ]ipapaŋaʔnia kuiŋ ru iniʔmu paprujqi
S.TRANSL: 他叫我去揹,但是我揹不動.
He asked me to carry it on the back, but I just couldn't.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處pakati'是丟掉/丟向一個地方之意。此處丟到他們睡覺的地方，丟的人有炫耀之意，目的是要讓其他人看到他所捕捉到的獵物。

S.FORM: muah sami ru maki sami kaykian havag ku vaisnia' pakati'nia' suku qaqalapannaha.
S.PHON: muaħ [s|ɕ]ami ru maki [s|ɕ]ami kajkian ħa*aɣ ku *ai[s|ɕ]niaʔ pakatiʔniaʔ [s|ɕ]uku qaqalapannaħa
S.FORM: muah sami ru maki sami kaykian havag ku vaisnia' pakati'nia' suku qaqalapannaha.
S.PHON: muaħ [s|ɕ]ami ru maki [s|ɕ]ami kajkian ħa*aɣ ku *ai[s|ɕ]niaʔ pakatiʔniaʔ [s|ɕ]uku qaqalapannaħa
S.TRANSL: 我們回來,然後我們在獵寮.(爸爸)他的同伴都把獵物丟到睡覺的地方(來炫耀).
We came back, and we were at the hunting hut. All his fellow companions threw (the preys) to the place for rest (to show off).

S.FORM: apau akusu uw taruiqun la ku ra huwal sannaha ku.
S.PHON: apau aku[s|ɕ]u uw taruiqun la ku ra ħuwal [s|ɕ]annaħa ku
S.FORM: apau akusu uw taruiqun la ku ra huwal sannaha ku.
S.PHON: apau aku[s|ɕ]u uw taruiqun la ku ra ħuwal [s|ɕ]annaħa ku
S.TRANSL: 他們說,哇,原來你吊到很大的東西.
Wow, indeed you hung something big big, they said.

S.FORM: gulgulunia maqas kahavag la.
S.PHON: ɣulɣulunia maqa[s|ɕ] kaħa*aɣ la
S.FORM: gulgulunia maqas kahavag la.
S.PHON: ɣulɣulunia maqa[s|ɕ] kaħa*aɣ la
S.TRANSL: 他的同伴都很高興.
All his fellow companions were glad.

FORM.notes: source note: m-<in>aras (AF型); pa-aras(FUT型); m-aras (AF型); aras (IMP型).

S.FORM: maqas la ru tiku tiqay ka quwau ka inarasnaha ga.
S.PHON: maqa[s|ɕ] la ru tiku tiqaj ka quwau ka inara[s|ɕ]naħa ɣa
S.FORM: maqas la ru tiku tiqay ka quwau ka inarasnaha ga.
S.PHON: maqa[s|ɕ] la ru tiku tiqaj ka quwau ka inara[s|ɕ]naħa ɣa
S.TRANSL: 高興以後,他們說帶的酒微不足道.
(They) were happy and (they said) the liquor that they brought was minor.

S.FORM: maqas la ru tiku tiqay ka quwau ka inarasnaha ga.
S.PHON: maqa[s|ɕ] la ru tiku tiqaj ka quwau ka inara[s|ɕ]naħa ɣa
S.FORM: maqas la ru tiku tiqay ka quwau ka inarasnaha ga.
S.PHON: maqa[s|ɕ] la ru tiku tiqaj ka quwau ka inara[s|ɕ]naħa ɣa
S.TRANSL: 高興以後,他們說帶的酒微不足道.
(They) were happy and (they said) the liquor that they brought was minor.

FORM.notes: source note: sayuk-an (LF型); h<um>au (AF型).

S.FORM: sihawnaha' sumayuk ku ruma'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iħawnaħaʔ [s|ɕ]umajuk ku rumaʔ
S.FORM: sihawnaha' sumayuk ku ruma'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iħawnaħaʔ [s|ɕ]umajuk ku rumaʔ
S.TRANSL: 他們倒酒給他後就燒山豬毛.
They poured the liquor to him (the hog hunter), and they burned its hair.

FORM.notes: source note: h<um>auving (AF型).

S.FORM: naqarun sumayuk hauvingunnaha'.
S.PHON: naqarun [s|ɕ]umajuk ħau*iŋunnaħaʔ
S.FORM: naqarun sumayuk hauvingunnaha'.
S.PHON: naqarun [s|ɕ]umajuk ħau*iŋunnaħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 燒完毛後,他們就切山豬.
After burning off the hair of the hog, they cut it.

S.FORM: XXXX tiku hi ga siaras i suku ulaqi imuwag.
S.PHON: xxxx tiku ħi ɣa [s|ɕ]iara[s|ɕ] i [s|ɕ]uku ulaqi imuwaɣ
S.FORM: XXXX tiku hi ga siaras i suku ulaqi imuwag.
S.PHON: xxxx tiku ħi ɣa [s|ɕ]iara[s|ɕ] i [s|ɕ]uku ulaqi imuwaɣ
S.TRANSL: 肉要帶給家裡面的小孩.
The meat was intended to be taken to the children at home.

FORM.notes: source note: giyus直譯為「腸子」, 但也有「內臟」之意.

S.FORM: tiku giyus la ga tahkun kiya i ragiyax la ru.
S.PHON: tiku ɣiju[s|ɕ] la ɣa taħkun kija i raɣijax la ru
S.FORM: tiku giyus la ga tahkun kiya i ragiyax la ru.
S.PHON: tiku ɣiju[s|ɕ] la ɣa taħkun kija i raɣijax la ru
S.TRANSL: 內臟的部分就在山上煮.
The internal organs were cooked in the mountains.

S.FORM: tuliq ru masay la ku tinahuk la qasugunnaha' la ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ru ma[s|ɕ]aj la ku tinaħuk la qa[s|ɕ]uɣunnaħaʔ la ru
S.FORM: tuliq ru masay la ku tinahuk la qasugunnaha' la ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ru ma[s|ɕ]aj la ku tinaħuk la qa[s|ɕ]uɣunnaħaʔ la ru
S.TRANSL: 然後,煮的東西已經熟了,他們就開始分(內臟).
And then, the stuff became well-done, and they started to allocate (the internal organs).

FORM.notes: source note: maymaw用來說明程度,「到...程度就...」.

S.FORM: maniq sami su mami' la ru manuvuwag su quwaw ru maymaw pana'is ku nanavakis gi paqasunnaha' la.
S.PHON: maniq [s|ɕ]ami [s|ɕ]u mamiʔ la ru manu*uwaɣ [s|ɕ]u quwaw ru majmaw panaʔi[s|ɕ] ku nana*aki[s|ɕ] ɣi paqa[s|ɕ]unnaħaʔ la
S.FORM: maniq sami su mami' la ru manuvuwag su quwaw ru maymaw pana'is ku nanavakis gi paqasunnaha' la.
S.PHON: maniq [s|ɕ]ami [s|ɕ]u mamiʔ la ru manu*uwaɣ [s|ɕ]u quwaw ru majmaw panaʔi[s|ɕ] ku nana*aki[s|ɕ] ɣi paqa[s|ɕ]unnaħaʔ la
S.TRANSL: 我們吃飯然後喝酒,然後老人們高興得開始唱歌,因為真的很開心.
We ate and then we drank the liquor, and the elders were so happy that they began to sing because they were really happy.

S.FORM: yani muwah sami ru.
S.PHON: jani muwaħ [s|ɕ]ami ru
S.FORM: yani muwah sami ru.
S.PHON: jani muwaħ [s|ɕ]ami ru
S.TRANSL: 然後我們就回來了.
And so we returned.

S.FORM: muwah sami imuwag ru.
S.PHON: muwaħ [s|ɕ]ami imuwaɣ ru
S.FORM: muwah sami imuwag ru.
S.PHON: muwaħ [s|ɕ]ami imuwaɣ ru
S.TRANSL: 我們回到家.
We came home.

S.FORM: muwah i mapatisan imuwag makaal maha mausa'ta' i kanuwan ma ru.
S.PHON: muwaħ i mapati[s|ɕ]an imuwaɣ makaal maħa mau[s|ɕ]aʔtaʔ i kanuwan ma ru
S.FORM: muwah i mapatisan imuwag makaal maha mausa'ta' i kanuwan ma ru.
S.PHON: muwaħ i mapati[s|ɕ]an imuwaɣ makaal maħa mau[s|ɕ]aʔtaʔ i kanuwan ma ru
S.TRANSL: 我們回到家裡後相互聊天,討論說什麼時候要去.
We came back and chatted with each other at home, discussing when would be the next visit.

S.FORM: sumku su riax su ausa' naha' mitaal lawwi.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]umku [s|ɕ]u riax [s|ɕ]u au[s|ɕ]aʔ naħaʔ mitaal lawwi
S.FORM: sumku su riax su ausa' naha' mitaal lawwi.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]umku [s|ɕ]u riax [s|ɕ]u au[s|ɕ]aʔ naħaʔ mitaal lawwi
S.TRANSL: 訂下日子下次再去巡陷阱.
(We) settled on the date and would check the trap again.

S.FORM: tuliq ru maka mapitu' ru halannaha' mitaal lawwi.
S.PHON: tuliq ru maka mapituʔ ru ħalannaħaʔ mitaal lawwi
S.FORM: tuliq ru maka mapitu' ru halannaha' mitaal lawwi.
S.PHON: tuliq ru maka mapituʔ ru ħalannaħaʔ mitaal lawwi
S.TRANSL: 然後,過了七天後他們又去看陷阱.
And then, seven days later, they went to check the trap again.

FORM.notes: source note: garg-an(LF型).

S.FORM: musa' sami lawwi ru gumru kung lawwi i yava'mu.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]ami lawwi ru ɣumru kuŋ lawwi i ja*aʔmu
S.FORM: musa' sami lawwi ru gumru kung lawwi i yava'mu.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]ami lawwi ru ɣumru kuŋ lawwi i ja*aʔmu
S.TRANSL: 我們又去一次,然後我又跟著爸爸去一次.
We went there again, and I followed Father there again.

S.FORM: tayhuk sami kiya qaat yani la ku tinruyqan taruyqunnia la hani tinruweq su para'.
S.PHON: tajħuk [s|ɕ]ami kija qaat jani la ku tinrujqan tarujqunnia la ħani tinruweq [s|ɕ]u paraʔ
S.FORM: tayhuk sami kiya qaat yani la ku tinruyqan taruyqunnia la hani tinruweq su para'.
S.PHON: tajħuk [s|ɕ]ami kija qaat jani la ku tinrujqan tarujqunnia la ħani tinruweq [s|ɕ]u paraʔ
S.TRANSL: 我們到那邊(獵場),在新的地方又吊到東西,就在這邊吊到山羌.
We arrived there (the hunting area), and we had something hung at a new place, and it was one muntjac.

FORM.notes: source note: al-an (LF型).

S.FORM: alun alunmiam ku para' ru.
S.PHON: alun alunmiam ku paraʔ ru
S.FORM: alun alunmiam ku para' ru.
S.PHON: alun alunmiam ku paraʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 我們就把山羌拿走.
We took away the muntjac.

S.FORM: tutingunniam ru alunniam.
S.PHON: tutiŋunniam ru alunniam
S.FORM: tutingunniam ru alunniam.
S.PHON: tutiŋunniam ru alunniam
S.TRANSL: 我們打了(山羌)之後,我們就把它拿走了.
We beat (the munjtac) and we took it away.

S.FORM: ru qutux suvalay ku para'miam.
S.PHON: ru qutux [s|ɕ]u*alaj ku paraʔmiam
S.FORM: ru qutux suvalay ku para'miam.
S.PHON: ru qutux [s|ɕ]u*alaj ku paraʔmiam
S.TRANSL: 我們只有獵到一隻山羌.
What we hunted was only one muntjac.

FORM.notes: source note: M-aglu (AF型). Siqun不完整, 應為ma-siqun.

S.FORM: siqun sami kaykian kahavag ku minaglu saspat.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iqun [s|ɕ]ami kajkian kaħa*aɣ ku minaɣlu [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]pat
S.FORM: siqun sami kaykian kahavag ku minaglu saspat.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iqun [s|ɕ]ami kajkian kaħa*aɣ ku minaɣlu [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]pat
S.TRANSL: 四個人一起隨後在獵竂集合.
All the four of us gathered at the hunting hut.

S.FORM: ku navakis niannaha rasun qutux lawwi ku vawak.
S.PHON: ku na*aki[s|ɕ] niannaħa ra[s|ɕ]un qutux lawwi ku *awak
S.FORM: ku navakis niannaha rasun qutux lawwi ku vawak.
S.PHON: ku na*aki[s|ɕ] niannaħa ra[s|ɕ]un qutux lawwi ku *awak
S.TRANSL: 我看到老人們又帶一隻山豬回來.
I saw the elderly bring back a hog again.

S.FORM: tuliq ru sayukannaha' nanu' asi naku manaaling musa' ka.
S.PHON: tuliq ru [s|ɕ]ajukannaħaʔ nanuʔ a[s|ɕ]i naku manaaliŋ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ka
S.FORM: tuliq ru sayukannaha' nanu' asi naku manaaling musa' ka.
S.PHON: tuliq ru [s|ɕ]ajukannaħaʔ nanuʔ a[s|ɕ]i naku manaaliŋ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ka
S.TRANSL: 然後他們燒毛就像他們當初去打獵的樣子.
And then, they burned its hair just like when they went hunting.

S.FORM: sinuvuwagnaha' ru.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]inu*uwaɣnaħaʔ ru
S.FORM: sinuvuwagnaha' ru.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]inu*uwaɣnaħaʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 他們就為此喝酒.
They drank for this.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句字面意: 他們的心很快樂。

S.TRANSL: 因為以前老人就是這樣,如果心裡高興的話,就會喝一點酒.喝完了酒,就會一直唱歌和睡覺直到第二天來臨,然後我們就分開.

The reason is that, in the past, the elders were like this. If they were happy at heart, they drank a little liquor. After that, (they) would keep singing and sleep until the next day. We did not part until the following day.
